blocks.text: The valley restores a slightly wrong version of the visitor’s outline.
Location: The Valley That Restores Wrong
Appearance: Local body patches reconstruct from the wrong portions of the actual character and retry.
Care: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
Story connection: A future restoration task could compare the comforting copy with the surviving original.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
